Both the appeals have arisen out of the Land Acquisition proceedings in Multai in Land Acquisition Case No. 8-A/82/2007-08 award dated 10.05.2010.
Appellants have filed reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act for enhancement of compensation for acquiring the land for construction of Sondhia Irrigation Dam.
Land Acquisition Officer, as per the submissions, awarded compensation of Rs.6,83,670/-.
On appeal Reference Court enhanced compensation to Rs. 10,20,515/-.

It is submitted by learned counsel for Shri Imrat Singh that now this 2 FA-330-2014 appeal is for enhancement of compensation by Rs.1,50,000/- whereas the State has filed the appeal for reduction of compensation amount.
It is submitted that whatever the award was passed by the Land Acquisition Officer that has been paid.
Now they have come for reduction of the amount awarded by the Reference Court.
Learned counsel for Shri Imrat Singh submitted that there was discrepancy in calculation regarding the number, length and width of fruit bearing and other trees.
Proper calculation has not been made.

sentences.text: Arguments on behalf of the State also focused on the same ground.
It is submitted that revenue authorities in connivance with the claimants mentioned more trees in their counting, therefore, they got the survey done from the Forest Department.
The Forest Department's report is Ex. P/4 which supports their averments, therefore, the amount should be reduced.

Learned counsel for the claimant Imrat Singh submitted that the trial Court has considered these objections in paragraphs 22 and 23 of its award and has mentioned that only one year compensation for loss of income from selling fruits has been considered.

He also submits that compensation was not paid within time, therefore, as per Section 28 of the Land Acquisiton Act rate of interest should be enhanced and this point has been covered in paragraph 39.
Learned counsel for the State did not dispute this legal position and submits that compensation was not paid within the stipulated time as mentioned in Section 28 of the Act.
Arguments heard and case is reserved for orders.

3 FA-330-2014 At the request of learned counsel for the State, let record of the case be scanned and uploaded for record purpose within 7 working days and then the file be returned back to this Court.
If the parties are interested they may file written submissions also.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE VSG Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111440976/
